name: Aspire11
decision_note: Prague-based pension-capital platform whose dominant strategy (Eternals) makes direct late-stage / pre-IPO minority investments in mature global tech companies (Databricks, Revolut, Vinted), with a fund-of-funds sleeve (Tribes) - typed pe under the revised type rule, so outside the VC pilot (S1).

funds.name: Aspire 11 Capital SICAV, a.s. (inaugural fund, Rentea commitment)

evidence.quote: Aspire11 se zaměřuje na produktové firmy v kategoriích s vysokou produktivitou (zemědělství, strojírenství, automotive, logistika, IT, hi-tech).
peníze nasměruje v podobě přímých vstupů do pokročilých růstových kol do globálně významných scale-upů
Investiční platforma Aspire11 představila strategii alokace 500 milionů eur (12,5 miliardy korun) z českého penzijního kapitálu do evropských a globálních technologických firem.
Aspire11 has deployed the first €100 million from its €515 million fund
The platform was launched in September 2025, with €500 million fully committed by Czech pension company Rentea
jde o přímou investici ve výši 20 milionů eur, tedy v přepočtu skoro půl miliardy korun
The first portfolio includes companies such as Revolut, ElevenLabs, Databricks, Vinted, VAST Data and Baseten.
Direct investments in late-stage and pre-IPO technology companies with enduring growth, market leadership, and long-term compounding potential.
Selective partnerships with leading and emerging venture capital funds across Europe and the US.
Direct investments in late-stage, category-defining companies — €10–50M concentrated positions in a small number of proven winners.
Companies in sample (Aspire11): Revolut, Vinted, VAST, Docplanner, Databricks.
We sit between Series B/C and Crossover investors, syndicating alongside the best and not competing — patient capital that compounds with the company and stays beyond IPO.

analyst_notes: Classification: dual strategy - Eternals (about 80% of capital per the Partners leaflet; EUR 300m per Lupa 2025-10-24) makes direct minority investments in growth-stage private tech companies; Tribes (EUR 100m) commits to 15-20 VC funds (fund-of-funds part, which alone would be E5). Because the dominant activity is direct growth-stage minority equity in VC-backed companies, the record is typed vc with stage growth; a reviewer could argue pe (large growth minority) - flagged. Ticket EUR 10-30m is the Eternals target investment per the Partners leaflet (undated 2025 marketing leaflet of the Partners group, which co-founded Aspire11; treated as B). Sector focus is the leaflet's stated list; the actual Eternals portfolio is mostly AI/data, fintech and e-commerce (Revolut, ElevenLabs, Databricks, Vinted, VAST Data, Baseten). Capital: Recursive 2026-07-15 says EUR 515m fund (EUR 500m committed by Rentea at launch in September 2025; month-only date recorded as 2025-09-01). Vinted: EUR 20m is Aspire11's own direct investment (round size not given), so round_amount is left empty; the Lupa item is authored by Aspire11 (press release), hence class B. Dates of Revolut/ElevenLabs/Databricks investments are not disclosed (in portfolio by 2026-07-15). Legal: Aspire 11 Capital SICAV is managed by Partners investiční společnost, a.s. (statutory body per ARES); Aspire 11 Capital Partners and Aspire 11 Advisers are Pavel Mucha's companies (roles not confirmed, recorded as other). The feeder 'Aspire 11 fond fondů 25' (IČO 75166020, Partners IS) is a distribution vehicle and not listed as a fund of the investor. No own website found (aspire11.com is an unrelated US apartment site). [revision 2026-10-25 after review: re-typed vc -> pe and decision include -> exclude S1. Own website aspire11cap.com exists (the earlier note that no website was found was wrong) and describes Eternals as direct investments in late-stage and pre-IPO technology companies positioned between Series B/C and crossover investors (e9, e14); Tribes backs VC funds (e11, fund-of-funds sleeve, E5-type). Late-stage / pre-IPO investing is pe under plan 10a; the EUR 20m Vinted stake likely was a secondary purchase (reviewer). No Czech portfolio company was found either, so S2 would also apply. sector_focus re-derived from the actual portfolio instead of the 2025 leaflet list: Revolut (fintech), Databricks, ElevenLabs, VAST Data, Baseten (ai_data), Vinted (ecommerce_marketplaces), Docplanner (healthtech) (e8, e13). Ticket updated to the own site's EUR 10-50m concentrated positions (e12, newest B); the 2025 Partners leaflet said EUR 10-30m (e2, kept as a conflict). Capital EUR 515m is the own site's 'Inaugural fund' size (e10), fully committed at launch (EUR 500m by Rentea); no close event is described, so the basis latest_fund_size rests on the fund being fully committed. e7 is a Lupa article by Iva Brejlová (class C, not an Aspire11 release).]
